scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:app && if [ -f .hutch/devkit/tsconfig.json ]; then tsc -p electrobun/tsconfig.json --noEmit; elif [ -n "${CI:-}" ]; then echo 'error: .hutch/devkit/tsconfig.json is missing: in CI the Electrobun devkit must be projected before typechecking — run bun run eb:build in this job, then typecheck' >&2; exit 1; else echo 'skip electrobun typecheck: .hutch/devkit/tsconfig.json is missing (the Electrobun devkit is not projected; bun run eb:build projects it)'; fi
scripts.typecheck:app: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p backend/tsconfig.json && tsc -p host/tsconfig.json
scripts.eb:dev: sh -c 'export NOD_APP_ID=${NOD_APP_ID:-copland.nod.eb-dev}; export NOD_DEV_PORT=${NOD_DEV_PORT:-5173}; bun scripts/build-nod-native.ts && bun scripts/eb-icon.ts && bun scripts/gen-electrobun-config.ts dev && { bun run dev & vite=$!; trap "kill $vite 2>/dev/null" EXIT INT TERM; electrobun dev --env=dev && bun scripts/eb-postbuild.ts --verify-only; }'
scripts.eb:build: bun scripts/build-nod-native.ts && bun scripts/eb-icon.ts && bun run build && bun scripts/gen-electrobun-config.ts build && electrobun build --env=stable && bun scripts/eb-postbuild.ts --verify-only && bun scripts/eb-sign.ts
